emergence.summary: A single-gene AGXT loss-of-function. The liver-peroxisomal enzyme alanine-glyoxylate aminotransferase normally detoxifies glyoxylate by transaminating it to glycine; when AGXT is deficient, glyoxylate is instead oxidised to oxalate, so endogenous oxalate is OVER-produced -> the toxic oxalate burden is driven UP (calcium-oxalate nephrolithiasis, nephrocalcinosis, and ultimately systemic oxalosis). Read as a released BRAKE on oxalate accumulation (AGXT brakes the build-up; LOF releases it -> burden UP) -- the tyrosinaemia / porphyria pattern. The kit re-derives the approved therapy, which RESTRAINS the UPSTREAM oxalate-producing flux rather than restoring AGXT: lumasiran (an HAO1/glycolate-oxidase-knockdown siRNA) lowers glyoxylate supply, and nedosiran (an LDHA-knockdown siRNA) lowers the final glyoxylate->oxalate step; both reduce oxalate production. Restoring AGXT itself (liver transplantation, historically the definitive correction; AGXT gene / hepatocyte therapy investigational) is the function-restoring lever. The gamma read is of the AGXT locus switch STRUCTURE; the disease lesion (e.g. the Gly170Arg peroxisome-to-mitochondrion mistargeting allele) is coding, outside the promoter firewall. Magnitude [O].

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology
grades.perturbation_magnitude: [O] OPEN -- how far the switch moves is runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable

per_gene.note: AGXT (alanine-glyoxylate aminotransferase) is the liver-peroxisomal enzyme that transaminates glyoxylate to glycine, keeping oxalate production in check. As a BRAKE on oxalate accumulation, its LOF RELEASES the brake -> glyoxylate is oxidised to oxalate and the toxic oxalate burden accumulates. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; it does NOT encode the coding lesion (firewall). The pathological axis is the TOXIC OXALATE BURDEN (it goes UP), so the corrective levers LOWER it.
per_gene.src: Danpure & Jennings 1986 (AGXT deficiency / peroxisomal mistargeting); Williams 2009 (AGXT mutation spectrum)

emergence.firewall: gamma reads promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only; perturbation DIRECTION is forced+cited; MAGNITUDE is [O] (runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable).

levers.push_direction: knock down the UPSTREAM glycolate oxidase (HAO1) so less glyoxylate is made -> lower oxalate production -> lower the toxic oxalate burden
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] oxalate-lowering / stone-rate magnitude not derived from sequence

levers.push_direction: knock down LDHA so the final glyoxylate->oxalate step is reduced -> lower oxalate production
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] oxalate-lowering magnitude not derived from sequence

levers.push_direction: restore AGXT so glyoxylate is detoxified to glycine again -> oxalate production falls -> lower the toxic burden (function-restoring / definitive)
levers.agent_class: AGXT restoration (liver transplantation; AGXT gene / hepatocyte therapy investigational)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] degree/durability of restored AGXT flux not derived from sequence
levers.src: Cochat & Rumsby 2013 NEJM (liver / combined transplant in PH1); Zheng 2020 (AAV-AGXT preclinical)

lead_corrective_lever.push_direction: knock down the UPSTREAM glycolate oxidase (HAO1) so less glyoxylate is made -> lower oxalate production -> lower the toxic oxalate burden
lead_corrective_lever.mechanism_grade: [O] oxalate-lowering / stone-rate magnitude not derived from sequence

modelling.grade: [F] ordering forced (over-shoot) ; delta/treat_frac documented choices ; realised magnitude [O]

treatment_A_switch.firewall: levers are DIRECTION + cited agent CLASS; not dose/potency/efficacy/safety, not a recommendation to treat any individual.

falsifiers.claim: AGXT LOF (released brake) raises the toxic oxalate burden (axis UP)
falsifiers.falsifier: an AGXT deficiency allele that LOWERED urinary / plasma oxalate would refute the released-brake direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: urinary oxalate excretion / plasma oxalate by AGXT genotype

falsifiers.claim: knocking down the upstream oxalate-producing flux (lumasiran HAO1 / nedosiran LDHA) is the CORRECTIVE direction (lowers the burden)
falsifiers.falsifier: if HAO1 or LDHA knockdown RAISED or failed to lower oxalate production, the restrain-upstream lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: urinary / plasma oxalate response to HAO1 or LDHA knockdown
